title: fix: Docker Hub short-name description
body:
This fixes a visual bug when using docker with a podman socket. You could get a `%!q(<nil>)` in the output, which this PR fixes:
```
printf 'FROM node:19\n' | DOCKER_BUILDKIT=0 \
  docker -H unix:///run/user/1000/podman/podman.sock build --pull -
DEPRECATED: The legacy builder is deprecated and will be removed in a future release.
            BuildKit is currently disabled; enable it by removing the DOCKER_BUILDKIT=0
            environment-variable.
```
